radiology_report:
Subject: Multiparametric MRI Prostate | Bravis Ziekenhuis | 15 Jan 2025
Indication: Evaluation of rising PSA value 3.6 and abnormal digital rectal examination.
Findings: The glandular volume registers at 30.24. T2-weighted sequences reveal a 12 mm focus of hypointensity within the left mid-gland peripheral zone. Diffusion-weighted imaging confirms marked restriction with correspondingly suppressed ADC values, characterizing this as a PI-RADS 4 lesion. Post-contrast phases demonstrate prompt, localized enhancement compared to adjacent tissue. The capsule remains intact without extraprostatic extension or seminal vesicle invasion. No suspicious nodal enlargement or bone metastases are evident.
Impression: Focal PI-RADS 4 lesion in the left mid-gland peripheral zone.
Prostate volume 30.24; PSA density 0.119.
csPCa probability 0.8235317.
